corpus.title: VN AI Content Kit: Vietnamese commerce content and local voice previews
corpus.text: Ali maintains this public MIT-licensed Node.js toolkit for Vietnamese product-ad copy, source-grounded evidence context, voice correction memory and offline narration previews. It provides a local MCP plugin and content/voice fine-tuning preparation. RAG retrieves evidence context without an attached answer-generation LLM. Local voice assets require separate installation and license review; each narration needs listening review. No trained weights, private campaign data, automatic publishing or measured campaign uplift are included or claimed. Reviewed at commit 7feb78d on 2 November 2026.

corpus.title: Optional recommendation signals
corpus.text: Collection starts off. Opt in under Help improve project recommendations in the guide. Uncheck to stop future collection and remove the local ID; previously aggregated counts cannot be individually removed. The local consent lasts 30 days. Daily hashed identifiers expire after two days; aggregate counts expire 30 days after their last increment. Recent counts only break close relevance ties; explicit project questions keep baseline retrieval. Sparse or unavailable signals give no boost. Counts are not sent to the model. Signals stay in Redis, separate from no-bloom PostgreSQL traffic. No individual-interest inference, vector search or measured quality improvement is claimed.

corpus.title: Traffic analytics: restricted hosted PostgreSQL imports
corpus.text: A batch pipeline exports no-bloom production daily Upstash aggregates into a private Supabase PostgreSQL schema. Fourteen local analytics tests cover replay, corrections, rollback, isolation and restricted permissions. Live TLS, reconciliation and replay passed; the first manually dispatched GitHub import passed on 26 October 2026. Daily scheduling is enabled, but the first clock-triggered execution has not yet been observed in the published report. Public examples are synthetic. Browser IDs and chat conversations are not exported. These totals are not portfolio recommendation signals, and customer impact is not claimed.

corpus.title: Portfolio guide: live baseline evaluation and limitations
corpus.text: On 26 October 2026, 16 live baseline requests returned 12 HTTP 200 responses and four service errors. Nine passed the original phrase and citation heuristics. This is a small authored development set, not factual accuracy or an independent benchmark. All failures remain in the report. Token usage and cost were unavailable. A later fix shows a labelled approved-source excerpt on generation failure; a full post-release live run is pending. No customer adoption or business uplift is claimed.

corpus.title: KKBox customer churn baseline: verified local results
corpus.text: KKBox is a public AI-assisted churn prototype with snapshot-date features, source-coverage inspection and synthetic future-event leakage checks. Features use events on or before 2017-02-28. Previously quoted performance scores are disputed and omitted. A within-cohort local holdout is not future-cohort validation, a Kaggle leaderboard result, a production model or measured retention impact. No numerical model-performance claim is made here.

Các điểm số đã nêu trước đây đang bị tranh chấp nên được lược bỏ. Holdout cục bộ cùng cohort không phải kiểm định cohort tương lai, điểm leaderboard Kaggle, mô hình production hay bằng chứng cải thiện giữ chân khách hàng.

corpus.title: Bounded local Qwen3 LoRA smoke experiment

Held-out assistant-token loss was considered separately from paired base/adapter generations, with raw outputs and model/adapter identities recorded. Strict JSON/source-link failures kept experimental wording outside approved CVs; no model wording was automatically promoted. This is not successful Qwen3-8B training, a production model or demonstrated quality improvement.
